title: Exact majority Fourier weight formula
statement: For natural numbers $m,j$ with $j\le m$, the level-$(2j+1)$ Fourier weight of majority on the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$ equals $\lambda_{2j+1}\,\frac{\pi}{2}(2m+1)I_{m-j}I_m$, where $I_q=\binom{2q}{q}/2^{2q}$ and $\lambda_k=\frac{2}{\pi}a_k$ for odd $k$, with $a_k=\frac{2}{k2^k}\binom{k-1}{(k-1)/2}$.
